Test24 replays only six operations and compares final snapshots, not a long fixed legal sequence with snapshot comparison throughout and sustained literal alternating fairness.
assert_invariants proves queued=>Ready but not Ready=>queued; exhaustive test therefore omits the every-Ready-exactly-once obligation.

findings.required_resolution: Preserve source_freeze_01.json; create a new numbered complete raw-byte manifest, immutable review context, explicit baseline/RED/build/wrapper/evidence dependency closure, before/after membership and byte readbacks.

findings.required_resolution: Preserve old reader/log; a new numbered fail-closed read-only reader must explicitly validate required schema/artifact set, complete current freeze, immutable reviewer pins, original protected list, F5 bindings/dispositions and native process observation.

findings.required_resolution: Populate a new task-owned pinned evidence/readback set without rewriting old evidence; include real commands/exits, all raw logs and provenance, immutable context and reviewer input pins before candidate dispatch.

findings.finding: Genuine logical RED is preserved in p12a_red_02.log:24 execute,3pass/21fail, actual cargo exit101 recovered from history. findings.required_resolution: Preserve and authenticate original runtime RED source/test bytes if recoverable, explicitly document post-RED oracle corrections/removal and corrected test-first provenance. findings.required_resolution: Reconcile actual unique commands/deltas and outcomes by defect; stop PARTIAL if any authority stop condition was crossed. Do not reset counters or count duplicate replayed history records as new attempts.

findings.required_resolution: Preserve the successful run. Establish elapsed/enforced-bound evidence from authenticated launch/completion records if possible; do not relabel suite time as wall time. Any authorized new measured run belongs to the parent, not this audit.

findings.required_resolution: Record exact authorized file-path allowlist and justified extensions; preserve old context snapshot before updating live checkpoint. Retain truthful PARTIAL and exclude live STATE from reviewer pins.

findings.required_resolution: Do not dispatch approval review as if prerequisites passed. findings.required_resolution: Retain the F5 historical pin; bind current lib bytes in P12-A freeze and explicitly disposition the sole authorized delta. Do not repin or modify F5 evidence.

clauses: 16.1 Attempt. An attempt is one distinct approach to fixing a specific defect, recorded in STATE.md or decisions.md with the command(s) used and the outcome. Rerunning the same command unchanged, or fixing an unrelated typo, is not a new attempt. Three failed attempts at the same defect = PARTIAL.

Extend it only with a justification in decisions.md before touching the new path. Commits are checked against it (§13).

16.9 Parent artifact integrity readback. A read-only parent script (saved as test_results/p12a/parent_readback_NN.py with JSON output) that: (a) re-hashes every input in the current freeze and shows source-before = source-after; (b) re-hashes every artifact cited in the P12-A evidence_manifest.json and checks each review JSON's recorded self-hash and the pinned inputs it names; (c) re-hashes the F5 predecessor files (FINAL_REPORT.md, evidence_manifest.json, the acceptance JSON) against the F5 manifest; (d) re-hashes every initially protected path and shows it equals the initial snapshot; (e) confirms no owned processes remain. It never edits anything. Save the output and cite it in the report.

source_safety_review.private_state: Policy holds private Snapshot only; all exported snapshots are copies, no mutation backdoor. Fixed arrays only; no allocation, unsafe, asm, hardware, atomics, locks, globals, callbacks, recursion or unbounded loops.
source_safety_review.determinism: No environmental/time inputs; two-slot scans select deterministic first unused slot and FIFO order.
source_safety_review.bounds: find_slot and first_unused return0/1/2 and callers guard2 before slot indexing. Admit has an unused slot, so at most1 consumed slot and queue_len<=1; append index0/1 and increment<=2. Running worker is not queued, so reschedule append sees queue_len<=1; its <2 guard is invariant-redundant. Dequeue checks nonzero, shifts two fixed cells, zeroes tail, subtracts bounded length and selects the valid Ready head. Enter255 and leave0 refuse before arithmetic; remaining u8 updates cannot overflow/underflow.
source_safety_review.semantics: ID/kind/duplicate/retired/inhibited/capacity and completion precedence match contract. Every refusal occurs before mutation; final leave clears pending then selects exactly once. Completion retires without requeue; consumed slots never reuse.
